prompt: Objective: grow a brewery's sales. What you've learned: bar sales fell 10% and supermarket sales rose 25%, and bar sales are falling across the whole beer category. Latest finding: supermarkets now make up half of sales. What is the best next step?

options.text: Find out why bar sales fell
options.feedback: Already answered: bar sales are falling across the whole category, not just for this brewery. The growth is in supermarkets.

options.text: Work out how bar and supermarket prices compare
options.feedback: Secondary to how to grow where demand is moving.

options.text: Let the interviewer choose which channel to focus on
options.feedback: Drive the case: the finding points to supermarkets.

options.text: Plan how to win more supermarket shelf space
options.feedback: Right. Supermarkets are the growing channel and half of sales, so grow there.

explanation: Bar sales are falling for the whole category, and supermarkets are now half of sales and growing. Work out how to win more shelf space.
